prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished original environmental background for a browser adventure game for high-school students, not a screenshot or a UI mockup.
Style: refined 2.5D isometric animated-feature environmental illustration; original design; believable human-scale architecture with softly rounded edges, subtle clean surface microtexture, finely resolved contact shadows, elegant architectural detail. Sophisticated and calm, not a preschool toy or miniatures photographed on a table.
Shared setting: a sunlit seaside academy city, warm ivory limestone walls, pale apricot tile roofs, sage-green plants, clear pale cyan sky and sea. Only orange and deep teal as strong accent colors. Soft bright daylight, realistic gentle shadows, airy and welcoming.
Composition: wide landscape 1536 by 1024. Architecture and detailed props concentrated at the left and right edges; central and lower-middle region remains spacious, uncluttered, quiet in contrast, usable behind actual readable interactive game panels. The image fills the whole canvas, no vignette or decorative frame.
Absolute constraints: entirely no text, no letters, no numerals, no formulas, no logo, no watermark, no signage; no rendered UI, cards, panels, buttons, overlays or interface elements. No people. No pixels, neon, glass cards, optical prisms, dark atmosphere, night scene, futuristic sci-fi, or childish plastic-toy treatment.
Scene: The Dual World Laboratory. Two small sunlit experimental academy pavilions are perfect mirrored architectural twins, one to the left and one to the right of a broad central passage. The matching buildings have identical warm ivory stone geometry and identical pale apricot roofs, inward-facing open laboratories with orderly counters. A restrained orange accent on the left contrasts with a restrained deep-teal accent on the right; do not use other strong accent colors. A simple wide, empty pale limestone demonstration worktable lies in the low central foreground, open and undecorated, leaving the center of the view unobstructed. Limited small scientific equipment stays on the peripheral side counters. Sage plants at outer corners and a distant glimpse of the cyan sea between the symmetrical pavilions. Architectural symmetry should be clear and exact, while light remains natural.

Scene: The Reasoning Tower in the same seaside academy. A distinctive warm ivory stone academy tower stands predominantly in the left third, capped by a pale apricot tiled roof and a small plain orange pennant without any marking. Elegant ascending exterior stairs and a series of stepped terraces climb from the right side toward the tower, forming a thoughtful, explorable architectural route. Low ivory walls, sage-green plants and pale apricot roofs of the neighboring seaside academy sit at the perimeter. Clear cyan sea and bright sky beyond. The entire lower central foreground is a broad open sunlit paved academy court with subtle cream stone joints, calm and almost empty for actual game interaction. Keep the tower fully recognizable without crowding the center; no maze, no puzzle symbols, no written signs.

A spacious top-floor observation terrace in clear warm afternoon daylight, with restrained warm ivory parapets and pale apricot roof fragments at the left and right outer edges. Sage-green plants in simple pale stone pots sit along the left peripheral parapet.
